story.title: Story 6: Startup Validation and Assignment Config

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on carried blocker SV-001 after the direct bounded fix. Reviewed the default assignment path, production createModelCall registry routing, Story 6 AC/TC evidence, exact PI package catalog evidence, focused tests, and configured gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: packages/pi-lhc/src/inference/model-call.ts now sets DEFAULT_PI_MODEL to `openai-codex/gpt-5.4`, and a direct built-artifact proof showed loadAssignments(undefined).smoothed_prompt returns `{provider:"openai-codex",model:"gpt-5.4",prompt:"smoothing-v1"}`. The production path still resolves through ctx.modelRegistry.find via createModelCall(ctx), and exact published package evidence closes the prior proof gap: @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@0.79.2 depends on @earendil-works/pi-ai ^0.79.2, and @earendil-works/pi-ai@0.79.2 dist/models.generated.js contains an `openai-codex` provider entry with model id `gpt-5.4`.

verified: AC-5.1 / TC-5.1: startup validation probes all seven assignments against PI modelRegistry before first derivation use
AC-5.2 / TC-5.2: unreachable lanes report kind, provider/model, reason, fix, headless log output, UI output, and health persistence
AC-5.3 / TC-5.3: validation failure leaves capture running and affected derivations are classified/queryable through health
AC-5.4 / TC-5.4: all seven defaults load provider/model/prompt, prompts resolve, and shipped default model is present in the PI 0.79.2 package catalog
AC-5.5 / TC-5.5: user assignment overrides take effect on next session start without code changes
TC-5.6: incomplete, unknown, placeholder, or unknown-prompt assignment config fails loudly
Story Gate: pnpm --filter pi-lhc verify passed
Epic Gate: pnpm --filter pi-lhc verify-all passed

gatesRun.command: pnpm --filter pi-lhc exec vitest run test/inference/assignments.test.ts test/inference/startup-validation.test.ts

additionalObservations: No material fake adapter, shim, placeholder branch, or non-real runtime path remains on the reviewed Story 6 production surfaces.

The in-code comment says PI records gpt-5.4 as the default openai-codex model, while @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@0.79.2 model-resolver defaults openai-codex to gpt-5.5; this is nonblocking for AC-5.4 because the exact @earendil-works/pi-ai@0.79.2 catalog proves openai-codex/gpt-5.4 exists.
